subject: website
name: slop.computer
summary: slop.computer, an onchain podcast front page built with Scaffold-ETH 2, open source (MIT) in the slop-computer-frontpage repository. It loads no script or frame from another host, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: its bundled wallet kit calls WalletConnect, Reown and Coinbase when it opens, and it needs Alchemy RPC reads and episode media from slop.computer hosts.

connections.name: WalletConnect and Reown (api.web3modal.org, pulse.walletconnect.org)
connections.note: Configuration and telemetry requests from the site's own bundled wallet kit when the page opens, before a wallet is connected.

connections.name: Coinbase wallet telemetry (cca-lite.coinbase.com)
connections.note: Posted by the bundled wallet kit when the page opens.

connections.name: Alchemy RPC (eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com)
connections.note: Chain reads when the page opens, no light client.

connections.name: Episode media (media.slop.computer, live.slop.computer)
connections.note: Images and metadata fetched when the page opens.
